claude_proposed_widenings.name: stateful_vehicle_magic_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is not an always-on grant or a one-shot activation. It is a persistent controllable object/vehicle with its own statistics, occupancy, sealed-compartment state, movement/attack affordances gated by lever positions, and environmental rules. The current magic-item surface has no family for a stateful vehicle or object that remains in play and is operated through repeated control inputs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
